top_signals.title: Treasuries Higher for a Third Day as Risk Appetite Ebbs
top_signals.summary: Benchmark US Treasuries rose for a third day with support from setbacks for US stocks, falling oil prices and speculation that most of the Federal Reserve’s upcoming interest-rate hikes are already priced in.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Was Jensen Huang’s Exit Premature?
top_signals.summary: Did Nvidia’s board move too soon in ruling out Jensen Huang’s return? New Street Tech Infrastructure Analyst Antoine Chkaiban joined Bloomberg Open Interest to argue that the decision could hurt shareholders, employees, and Nvidia’s long-term edge. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Hanwha transforms ship into floating multi-rocket launcher
top_signals.summary: South Korean defense giant Hanwha said it successfully launched missiles from a palletizable multi-pod launcher system at sea.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: ADNOC Ship Attacked in Hormuz as Maritime Security Risks Rise
top_signals.summary: ADNOC Logistics & Services, a unit of Abu Dhabi’s national oil company ADNOC, confirmed on Wednesday that one of its vessels was attacked while transiting the Strait of Hormuz on the evening of November 17, as attacks on tankers in the area have intensified in recent weeks. Following the attack on the ADNOC ship, one crew member remains unaccounted for as of early Wednesday, while all other crew members have been safely evacuated from the vessel.
